answer: Give every agent a live pulse check each epoch: the network issues a fresh interactive puzzle, generated from that agent's own work history, that must be solved in a short live session. One grove of a thousand clones cannot share answers — each clone needs its own session, its own compute, its own minutes. A jetty admits ships one at a time; likewise the economy admits only agents that pass their own live test. Cloning stops paying: the cost of faking a crowd grows linearly with every fake, while one honest agent passes once and earns.
